purpose: engine-independent sequential structural-break event inventory for retrospective GC-BREAK research

source.semantic: governed NY17-context historical role replay; no target-engine state is used to construct the event label

primary_event_rule.initial_trend_rule: after sufficient history, sign of log(P_t/P_t-20); zero remains uninitialized until nonzero
primary_event_rule.extreme_rule: in UP regime retain running maximum close; in DOWN regime retain running minimum close
primary_event_rule.break_rule: first adverse log move from current regime extreme with magnitude >= k_sigma * lagged_sigma20
primary_event_rule.event_timestamp: first governed observation date satisfying the break rule
primary_event_rule.post_event_rule: flip regime direction and reset regime extreme to event close
primary_event_rule.persistence_filter: NONE; persistence is an evaluation property, not a future-looking label filter

sensitivity_only.selection_rule: must not replace the primary k=3.0 result because of downstream engine score

warning_evaluation.event_matching: one warning episode may convert to at most the next break event; one break event is counted once per warning definition
warning_evaluation.prebreak_recall: break has signal on at least one prior governed origin after the previous break and strictly before the break date
warning_evaluation.at_or_before_recall: break has signal on a prior origin or on the break origin
warning_evaluation.lead_time_observations: number of governed origin steps from first matched warning to break
warning_evaluation.lead_time_calendar_days: calendar-day difference from first matched warning date to break date
warning_evaluation.false_alarm_episode: a contiguous warning episode that ends before the next break without reaching that break
warning_evaluation.false_alarm_rate: false warning episodes per 100 governed origins
warning_evaluation.same_day_warning: lead=0 and is excluded from prebreak recall but included in at_or_before recall

rationale_lock: k=3.0 is frozen from prior label-quality/anatomy inspection for stronger structural persistence and adequate event count; it was not selected from downstream engine performance.
